_comment: MEASURED via Phase-B controlled duels (2026-09-02, raw logs carry exact server hit_chance/hit_roll/hit_success per shot): hit_chance_by_distance [d0..d6] equal-speed deterministic (d1=0.80 inferred, never settled at distance 1); hit_chance_a/b set to the measured engaged (d0) 0.90; brace_regen_mult 2.5 (S4c battle 7be5cbe0: braced un-hit regen ~2.5x recharge, FLAT on a boosted max-75 pool, disproving 5%-of-max); regen_from_zero FALSE (S5 + 40+ wildlife timelines); regen_hit_divisor 3, brace_in_mult 0.25 (Haven fixture); evade_in_mult 0.5 / evade_accuracy_debuff 0.20 (skill.md + S3). flee_ticks_required base 3 is the equal-speed value; the full law is deterministic flee_required = max(1, 3 + 2*(pursuer_speed - fleer_speed)) -- pure speed, NO Tactics term (S6a/S6c2/S6d, four points fit exactly). SPEED->hit_chance modifier is asymmetric on (attacker_speed - target_speed) at d0: +2 -> 0.95, 0 -> 0.90, -1 -> 0.81, -2 -> 0.78 (S2/S8) -- documented for the v2 zone/speed engine, NOT consumed by the v1 flat-hit engine. armor constants: see analysis scripts. Tank note (S8): 70% DR + shield-type absorption stack to ~90% effective (pulse 10 raw -> 1 net on a 600 shield).
